game: Sonic the Hedgehog (1991, Game Gear Rev 1)
target: Original World Rev 1 Game Gear cartridge build, played through PC emulation

areas.name: Green Hill Zone
areas.location_cue: Bright grass, palms, waterfalls, and low checker-patterned cliffs.
areas.note: The Game Gear's reduced view and revised geometry make its fixed routes distinct from the Master System release.

save_backup.title: Create a save state before each goal
save_backup.why: The handheld cartridge has no native save file, and an act exit closes every missed local reward.
save_backup.detail: Keep one state at the act entrance and another before the goal until its life monitor, emerald, panel reward, and clear are reconciled.

point_of_no_return.title: The goal closes the current act
point_of_no_return.why: Normal play cannot walk backward into a completed act.
point_of_no_return.detail: Finish the local checklist before touching the goal panel or completing the third act's final obstacle sequence.

levels.1: Keep a clean ring reserve while you examine the safer branches ahead.
levels.2: Reach the Act 1 goal; finish with 50–99 rings if the next Special Stage is still needed.
levels.3: Follow the upper grass route, keep enough rings for the planned reward, and touch the goal panel. There is no emerald in this act; reconcile the hidden life and the act-specific panel total before exiting.

levels.1: An early palm tree briefly advertises that it is unusual.
levels.2: After the first spike pit, jump into the sparkling palm from below.
levels.3: Move beyond the opening spike pit and watch the nearby palms. One tree flashes; stand beneath its trunk and jump upward through the canopy to release the concealed extra life, then collect it before advancing.

levels.1: Keep a clean ring reserve while you examine the safer branches ahead.
levels.2: Reach the Act 2 goal; finish with 50–99 rings if the next Special Stage is still needed.
levels.3: Reach the second act's panel after resolving the first upward-spring branch. Carry 50–99 rings only if you want a Special Stage; otherwise preserve the separate panel-life band and finish deliberately.

levels.1: The first pool conceals more width than the screen suggests.
levels.2: At the first water section, walk left through the solid-looking wall.
levels.3: Enter the first shallow water area, turn back, and press into its left boundary. The wall is passable; continue through it, break the hidden life monitor, and return the same way before taking the main route.

levels.1: The checkpoint conceals a route behind the spring you are expected to use.
levels.2: From the checkpoint, go left past the spring, take the short tunnel, and descend the waterfall.
levels.3: After the checkpoint, jump left to the nearby spring but do not bounce on it. Walk left through the short tunnel, clear the enemy, and drop with the waterfall into the hidden chamber. The emerald rests on the ledge to the right; use the chamber's waterfall to return to the earlier pool.

levels.1: Complete every nearby fixed check before committing to this act's exit.
levels.2: Reach and complete the final obstacle sequence in Act 3, then cross its outgoing boundary.
levels.3: Stay near the far-left safe ground while the moving craft approaches. Jump into it during each low pass, avoid being caught beneath it, and repeat until eight clean hits end the act; collect the fixed life first.

levels.1: One safe-looking gap hides a lower shelf instead of a fall.
levels.2: Before the steep hill, drop through the hole without spikes and inspect the shelf beside the spring.
levels.3: Approach the steep uphill section and choose the preceding opening that has no spikes. Drop into it under control, land on the lower shelf, move to the right of the spring, and break the life monitor before returning upward.

levels.1: A clean act changes the reward shown by its goal panel.
levels.2: Reach the Act 1 goal without taking a hit; keep the total below 50 while testing this result.
levels.3: Make a state at the Act 1 entrance, then clear the act without any enemy or hazard removing a shield or rings. For an unambiguous test, finish with 1–49 rings and avoid a multiple of ten. Touch the panel and let it settle on the extra-life result; reload after any hit.

levels.1: A clean act changes the reward shown by its goal panel.
levels.2: Reach the Act 2 goal without taking a hit; keep the total below 50 while testing this result.
levels.3: Make a state at the Act 2 entrance, then clear the act without any enemy or hazard removing a shield or rings. For an unambiguous test, finish with 1–49 rings and avoid a multiple of ten. Touch the panel and let it settle on the extra-life result; reload after any hit.

areas.note: The Game Gear's reduced view and revised geometry make its fixed routes distinct from the Master System release.

levels.1: Keep a clean ring reserve while you examine the safer branches ahead.
levels.2: Reach the Act 1 goal; finish with 50–99 rings if the next Special Stage is still needed.
levels.3: Cross the open spans without losing the ring total chosen for your goal reward. Resolve the second counterweight, collapsing-bridge emerald route, and panel band before touching the finish.

levels.1: A second counterweight can launch you higher than its first bounce suggests.
levels.2: Use the second seesaw twice, then hold right during the high launch.
levels.3: Stand on the second counterweight seesaw and let its weight launch you. Land back on it for a stronger second bounce, hold right in the air, and steer onto the high ledge containing the life monitor.

levels.1: A collapsing bridge can become an elevator if you leave it late.
levels.2: Near the end, ride the first collapsing bridge section downward and jump left to the lower platform.
levels.3: At the long collapsing bridge near the goal, remain on its first falling segment instead of racing across. Descend with it briefly, then jump left before it drops off-screen. Land on the concealed lower platform and collect the emerald.

levels.1: Keep a clean ring reserve while you examine the safer branches ahead.
levels.2: Reach the Act 2 goal; finish with 50–99 rings if the next Special Stage is still needed.
levels.3: The screen advances on its own, so stay near the middle and read the river before committing to each platform. Secure the low floating life and chosen goal total, then reach the panel without being pushed off-screen.

levels.1: The automatic camera briefly hides a reward close to the waterline.
levels.2: Around the middle of the act, duck to inspect the low river and prepare to land on the floating life.
levels.3: During the mid-to-late auto-scrolling section, keep enough space from the right edge to react. Duck when the river opens below; the life appears low over the water. Drop onto its small safe platform, collect it, and immediately recover to the advancing route.

levels.1: Complete every nearby fixed check before committing to this act's exit.
levels.2: Cross the opening bridge, then use the space above the craft as it rises between the two pits.
levels.3: After the bridge, wait beside the paired pits. The craft rises from one opening, pauses, and fires a three-shot spread. Stay directly above its centre so the spread misses, then land on the middle of the craft; holding the jump can produce a second bounce. Reach eight hits and take the exit.

levels.1: The third act rewards checking the direction opposite progress immediately.
levels.2: Walk left from the Act 3 starting position.
levels.3: Do not move right when the act loads. Turn around at once, walk left behind the starting point, and break the life monitor in the small off-screen pocket before beginning the normal route.

levels.1: A clean act changes the reward shown by its goal panel.
levels.2: Reach the Act 1 goal without taking a hit; keep the total below 50 while testing this result.
levels.3: Make a state at the Act 1 entrance, then clear the act without any enemy or hazard removing a shield or rings. For an unambiguous test, finish with 1–49 rings and avoid a multiple of ten. Touch the panel and let it settle on the extra-life result; reload after any hit.

levels.1: Keep a clean ring reserve while you examine the safer branches ahead.
levels.2: Reach the Act 1 goal; finish with 50–99 rings if the next Special Stage is still needed.
levels.3: Use the waterfall platforms patiently and keep the ring total required for your chosen goal outcome. Finish only after both the first-waterfall life and third-waterfall emerald routes are complete.

levels.1: A stepped waterfall shortly before the checkpoint continues above the obvious ledge.
levels.2: At the rocky waterfall before the checkpoint, climb from the rightmost ledge toward the upper-left shelves.
levels.3: Stop at the waterfall with stone ledges just before the checkpoint. Jump to the rightmost ledge, then work upward and left across the higher shelves. The life monitor sits at the end of that elevated chain; collect it before dropping back to the main route.

levels.1: The third log waterfall has safe ground below the normal camera line.
levels.2: At the third waterfall, duck to lower the view, drop to the grass, then reach the river log and ride it left.
levels.3: At the third large waterfall, stand on the opening stone platforms and duck so the handheld view reveals grass below. Drop to that ground, cross to the stone platform and next grassy ledge, then jump onto the river log. Run left with it until the concealed alcove containing the emerald appears.

levels.1: Keep a clean ring reserve while you examine the safer branches ahead.
levels.2: Reach the Act 2 goal; finish with 50–99 rings if the next Special Stage is still needed.
levels.3: Climb continuously because the Master System camera never returns downward. Resolve the left-edge life before it falls below the screen, protect the intended ring count, and touch the goal panel at the top.

levels.1: The second act hides its reward at the lowest edge of a right-hand division.
levels.2: In the checkpoint section, take the lowest route all the way right and drop beside the wall.
levels.3: Reach the broad section containing the checkpoint and descend to its lowest traversable level. Continue fully right rather than climbing, then drop at the right wall. Land beside the concealed life monitor, collect it, and return before committing to the next upward section.

levels.1: Complete every nearby fixed check before committing to this act's exit.
levels.2: Climb to the upper vine and use its right edge to control where each rolling bomb lands.
levels.3: Fight from the steep curved vine. Stand near its right edge so the craft crosses overhead and drops a bomb onto the vine; move away before the bomb rolls toward the centre and explodes. Strike during the low pass or descent, then repeat until eight hits clear the act.

levels.1: The first vine distracts from a submerged reward immediately ahead.
levels.2: Ignore the first vine, walk right into the water, and search beneath the surface.
levels.3: Pass the first climbable vine without using it and continue directly into the water. The life monitor is submerged close to the entry point; collect it, surface safely, then return to the vine for the act's main route.

levels.1: Keep a clean ring reserve while you examine the safer branches ahead.
levels.2: Reach the Act 1 goal; finish with 50–99 rings if the next Special Stage is still needed.
levels.3: Manage air before exploring the lower passages, then keep the ring band needed at the goal. The late switch-and-monitor secret must be resolved before you leave.

levels.1: A late ordinary monitor changes when a nearby switch is pressed first.
levels.2: Near the lone ten-ring monitor, activate the switch on its left before breaking it.
levels.3: Late in the act, locate the isolated ten-ring monitor but do not strike it. Move left and press the nearby floor switch; return after the change, then break the monitor in its transformed state to receive the extra life.

levels.1: Keep a clean ring reserve while you examine the safer branches ahead.
levels.2: Reach the Act 2 goal; finish with 50–99 rings if the next Special Stage is still needed.
levels.3: Keep an air source within reach while checking the lower fork and the temporary-invincibility branch. Reconcile both fixed prizes before carrying the selected ring total to the goal.

levels.1: The first fork's lower branch continues beneath a dangerous ceiling.
levels.2: At the first wall-mounted fork, take the lower-left route, collect air, then continue to the far left.
levels.3: Choose the lower-left passage at the first fork. Refresh your air, descend, and travel left beneath the ceiling spikes without jumping into them. Break the life monitor at the far end, then use the spring route to escape.

levels.1: The emerald waits behind the goal approach rather than inside an invincibility route.
levels.2: Just before the Act 2 goal, walk left through the final hallway to its far end.
levels.3: Reach the last hallway immediately before the goal panel, but do not touch the panel. Turn around and travel all the way left. The emerald sits openly on a small ledge at the hallway's far end; collect it, then return right to finish the act.

levels.1: Complete every nearby fixed check before committing to this act's exit.
levels.2: Stay clear of the centre opening and prepare for alternating side torpedoes.
levels.3: The craft first appears in the centre and fires paired square shots; jump onto it once. It then descends from a side opening and launches a torpedo that lowers before crossing the room. Strike during the descent, retreat far left or opposite the torpedo, and repeat patiently until eight hits open the exit.

levels.1: The starting spring reaches a prize only if you steer against the expected direction.
levels.2: Use the opening spring while holding left and cross the spike corridor to its far end.
levels.3: At the start, enter the spring while holding left and land in the spike-lined corridor. Move to its far-left end for the life monitor. Escaping is harder than entering: carry a shield if possible so one spike contact can drop you clear, then return carefully to the spring route.

levels.1: Complete every nearby fixed check before committing to this act's exit.
levels.2: Reach and complete the final obstacle sequence in Act 1, then cross its outgoing boundary.
levels.3: Moving machinery can carry a fixed reward off the safe floor. Collect it before the second conveyor ends, then choose the exact panel total you want at the goal.

levels.1: The first exterior conveyor can carry its reward away before you react.
levels.2: After leaving the first hallway, intercept the life monitor on the conveyor immediately outside.
levels.3: Exit the opening hallway and look at the conveyor before stepping onto it. The life monitor is already moving toward the edge; meet it quickly, break it while both you and the monitor remain over safe flooring, then continue through the exterior machinery.

levels.1: Complete every nearby fixed check before committing to this act's exit.
levels.2: Reach and complete the final obstacle sequence in Act 2, then cross its outgoing boundary.
levels.3: The first route split controls both fixed rewards. Use a state before the fork, complete the upper-switch detour and teleporter paths, then approach the goal with the required panel band.

levels.1: The upper fork contains three drops and a transporter beyond the last.
levels.2: Take the upper fork, fall through the third pit, go right into the transporter, then look left after arrival.
levels.3: At the major fork, choose the upper room and count the floor openings. Cross the first two, drop through the third, and enter the transporter on the right. In the destination room, move left from the arrival device to collect the emerald before taking the exit.

levels.1: The lower branch loops through a ground-floor transporter and back toward the fork.
levels.2: At the fork, take the lower route, roll into the pit, then use the transporter on the left.
levels.3: Choose the lower path at the main fork and roll down its slope into the pit that reaches the ground floor. Move left into the transporter. After it relocates you, travel right to the life monitor; this route then returns to the original fork.

levels.1: Complete every nearby fixed check before committing to this act's exit.
levels.2: Use the ground-route pit to enter the door maze, then favour the left path at the high fork after collecting the life branch.
levels.3: Take the ordinary ground branch to its apparent dead end and drop into the pit to reveal the working door. Follow the spring chain upward. At the high fork, use right only for the long-shaft life; return and take left to advance. Ignore the ring pit that loops to the start, adjust the final door switch only if needed, then leave through the right-hand exit.

levels.1: A high fork in the maze sends the correct route down a long shaft.
levels.2: At the upper left-or-right choice, go right, fall down the long shaft, then move left on the ground floor.
levels.3: Climb through the door-and-spring maze until its high directional fork. Choose right and commit to the long drop. After landing on the ground floor, move left to the life monitor. Return to the route only after the pickup is registered.

levels.1: Complete every nearby fixed check before committing to this act's exit.
levels.2: Reach and complete the final obstacle sequence in Act 1, then cross its outgoing boundary.
levels.3: Read each lightning chain from its diamond markers, avoid the cannons, and remember that jumping pauses a moving platform. Stay low long enough to recover the fixed life, then finish with the chosen panel count.

levels.1: The second propeller platform passes above a lower chain of safe landing points.
levels.2: After riding the second propeller platform, drop onto the platforms below.
levels.3: Count the propeller platforms and ride the second far enough to line up the lower route. Drop onto the small platforms beneath it rather than continuing high. Follow that lower chain through the ring cluster to the life monitor, then rejoin the forward route.

levels.1: Complete every nearby fixed check before committing to this act's exit.
levels.2: Reach and complete the final obstacle sequence in Act 2, then cross its outgoing boundary.
levels.3: No ordinary rings protect this crossing. Wait for the first lower platform, follow the underside chain, and reconcile both the ladder life and emerald deck before taking the route onward.

levels.1: A hidden propeller platform waits left of the start and leads to a guarded ladder.
levels.2: Jump left from the opening to the concealed propeller platform; ride it to the second ladder.
levels.3: At the start, jump left into the apparently empty space and land on the hidden propeller platform. Follow that route until another propeller passes beside the second ladder. Climb the ladder, avoid the cannon guarding the top, and break the life monitor before continuing.

levels.1: The concealed propeller route eventually reaches the ship's forward deck.
levels.2: Take the hidden platform left of the start and continue to the bow beside the corkscrew-shaped fixture.
levels.3: Use the concealed propeller platform left of the starting point and remain on its connected shortcut until it reaches the forward deck. The emerald lies near the bow beside a corkscrew-shaped object and is required along that route. From the ordinary chain descent, continue right later to reach the same deck.

levels.1: Complete every nearby fixed check before committing to this act's exit.
levels.2: Track the flame cycle across three positions and keep left when the overhead bolt begins homing.
levels.3: Inside the glass arena, the flame cycle always moves left, right, then centre. When the overhead electrical bolt starts tracking you, wait on the left side to evade it. Attack the glass case during each safe opening and repeat until twelve hits break the defence, then use the outgoing transporter.

levels.1: The opening life depends only on surviving the immediately previous act.
levels.2: Finish Sky Base Act 2 without losing a life; the monitor appears at the Act 3 start.
levels.3: Make a state at the start of Sky Base Act 2 and complete that act without any death or restart that consumes a life. When Act 3 loads, the conditional life monitor stands directly in front of the starting position. If absent, reload Act 2 and repeat it cleanly.

levels.2: Reach the Act 1 goal without taking a hit; keep the total below 50 while testing this result.
levels.3: Make a state at the Act 1 entrance, then clear the act without any enemy or hazard removing a shield or rings. For an unambiguous test, finish with 1–49 rings and avoid a multiple of ten. Touch the panel and let it settle on the extra-life result; reload after any hit.

areas.name: Bonus Stages
areas.location_cue: Four handheld spring-and-bumper courses, then four faster repeat visits with added obstacles.
areas.note: Enter from Zones 1–4 Acts 1 or 2 with 50–99 rings; the first four visits allow two minutes, while visits five through eight allow one.

save_backup.title: Save before the eligible goal panel
save_backup.why: The handheld cartridge has no native save file, and an act exit closes every missed local reward.
save_backup.detail: Keep the state from before the goal, then refine the ring total and bonus route without replaying the entire cartridge.

point_of_no_return.title: The bonus exit ends the attempt
point_of_no_return.why: The timer expiring or touching the exit ends the current visit.
point_of_no_return.detail: Collect its fixed rewards and chosen ring total before entering the exit; reload the pre-goal state after a failed audit.

levels.1: The first course rewards calm use of its coloured springs.
levels.2: Climb toward the upper section, collect the fixed continue, then return toward the exit near the starting side.
levels.3: Enter with 50–99 rings and use the full two-minute first-visit timer. Purple, orange, and green springs provide progressively stronger launches. Work upward for the fixed continue monitor, collect useful rings without reaching an unwanted reset, then return toward the exit positioned near the starting side. This layout has no fixed life monitor.

levels.1: The second course begins on solid ground and hides its continue above a bumper basket.
levels.2: Approach the continue from the left, fall between the two bumpers, then recover right for the life monitor.
levels.3: Use the two-minute timer to approach the central bumper basket from the left. Drop between its two bumpers to reach the fixed continue, then escape toward the right-hand life monitor. Preserve enough time to reach the exit; repeated bouncing between the bumper and spring can trap you.

levels.1: A rightward route is slowed by springs deliberately pointing backward.
levels.2: Travel from left to right, refusing weak springs that reverse progress; collect the fixed continue and life en route.
levels.3: Move steadily right for the full course and do not accept purple springs aimed back toward the start. The continue and life monitors sit along the successful line. Use short corrections after each bounce, gather the planned ring total, and reach the exit before the two-minute timer expires.

levels.1: The fourth course is a controlled vertical fall through bumpers and flippers.
levels.2: Stay near the centre during the descent; collect the continue and choose one reachable life before the final exit.
levels.3: Descend through the central bumper field while the two-minute timer runs. Use the flippers to recover upward after a miss, take the fixed continue, and collect one of the four displayed life opportunities—the layout permits only one. Enter the last drop with enough time to reach the exit.

levels.1: The first layout returns with moving obstacles and half the original time.
levels.2: Repeat Visit 1's upper continue route, now avoiding the added moving bumpers within one minute.
levels.3: Follow the first layout's upper route, but wait for each added moving bumper before committing to a spring. Collect the continue and the added life monitor, then return toward the exit. The repeat visit allows only one minute, so reload the pre-goal state after any extended ricochet.

levels.1: The ground-start layout returns with moving bumpers crowding its central basket.
levels.2: Repeat Visit 2's left approach to the continue, then recover right for the life within one minute.
levels.3: Approach the central basket from the left as before, timing the drop around the added moving bumpers. Secure the continue, escape right for the life monitor, and head directly to the exit. The one-minute limit leaves little recovery time if a spring traps you.

levels.1: The rightward course returns with more moving obstacles and a one-minute limit.
levels.2: Maintain Visit 3's rightward line while waiting for added bumpers and rejecting backward springs.
levels.3: Use short, deliberate launches along the rightward route. Let moving bumpers clear, avoid every purple spring that reverses direction, and collect the fixed continue and life while passing. With only one minute, reload immediately if the course sends you back more than once.

levels.1: The final visit compresses the vertical pinball descent into one minute.
levels.2: Repeat the central Visit 4 descent, using flippers only for the continue or reachable life.
levels.3: Drop along the central line, time the added moving bumpers, and use a flipper recovery only when it preserves the continue or the single reachable life. The timer is one minute, so abandon unnecessary ring detours and commit to the final exit as soon as both fixed rewards are secured.

areas.name: Cartridge Completion Audit
areas.location_cue: A non-geographic checklist reconciled from retained emulator states and result screens.
areas.note: This original cartridge has no persistent unlock menu; the audit records its finite branches and reward systems without inventing external cheat-device content.

levels.1: Keep one late save state before your emerald set becomes complete.
levels.2: Preserve a state before the Sky Base Act 2 bow, then finish while leaving that emerald uncollected.
levels.3: Create a state before the final emerald on Sky Base Act 2's forward deck. Leave it untouched on this branch, complete the last act, and retain the result screen. Reload the state afterward so the complete branch does not require a second full cartridge run.
